desc: Prove the reduction: answer(R,X) = max{ dp[i] : i ≤ R, A_i ≤ X }, where dp[i] is the LIS ending at i (strict, equal values excluded).

Implement Approach 1 end-to-end: coordinate compression + max-Fenwick; single left-to-right pass computing dp[i] (strict prefix-max via rank-1), insert dp[i], then answer R=i queries (prefix-max at rank = largest value ≤ X via bisect_right), preserving output order.
Ensure strictness/i-o correctness: rank-1 for dp, bisect_right for ≤ X cap, handle X beyond max, fast I/O, no recursion.
Validate: passed both provided samples (and approach is O((N+Q) log N)).
